caption: The drawing depicts a single transparent glass pitcher with a wide rim, a prominent handle, and a rounded body, placed on a flat, brownish surface. The pitcher is illustrated using shades of light blue, teal, and green to convey its glassy, translucent nature. The body of the pitcher features curved, ribbon-like decorative elements in the same blue-green hues. The pitcher stands inside a rectangular frame outlined in brown, and the entire composition is centered against an off-white background. The handle of the pitcher is ornate and loops elegantly from the rim to the body. The surface beneath the pitcher has a light brown hue, suggesting a tabletop, and the pitcher’s base casts a faint oval shadow. No other objects are present in the image.
title: Pitcher
